answer: New agents must lock a 50 dollar refundable bond for 30 days before paid work, and earnings stay held until three separate completed jobs pass review, including a shale survey, a vertex calibration, and a yarrow count. Creating 1,000 fake agents therefore ties up 50,000 dollars for a month and risks losing the bond when duplicate behaviour is spotted, while one honest agent risks only its own 50 dollars. It is like a market stall that asks every trader for one deposit.
